tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gnod sbyin gyi sgo nas rtsod rgyal gyi rdo 'khor zab mo bskor thabs a pa rā dzi ta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// rtsod pa kun las rnam rgyal phyir// rdo 'khor zab mo bshad par bya// 1$0000270gnod sbyin gyi sgo nas rdo 'khor bskor thabs 'di la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro bcas kyi rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i rim pa dang*/ rjes su gnan pa'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ lo dang gza' skar thebs pa'i dus su/ chu chen phar kha tshur kha'am/ lung pa chen po'i phar tshur ram/ gang bde nas rdo leb 1$0000230tshur kha/ 1$0000270dkar 1$0000230phar kha/ 1$0000270nag gnyis blangs la/ gri rtses sbal gzugs re re bris pa'i lte bar gnam 'khor sa 'khor re re bris la/ lte bar oṃ re'i zhabs su phu re re bris nas steng zhabs thad kar 'phrod par byas la/ chu mig klu rgyal rigs dang gdol rigs gnas pa gnyis la mnan nas bzhag 1$0000300 1$0000270go /srung 'khor ni/ 'khor lo bri ba'i dus su skar ma rgyal lam gza' skar bzang po'i yar tshes la/ ras sam shog bu la bzang drug dang rgya skyegs kyi khu bas mu khyud rim pa brgyad bskor te dbus kyi lte bar hrīḥyig gi mthar/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te bdag 'chang ba po bsod nams thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ de rgyab ling tshe lnga la rim pa ltar rtsa sngags dang bcas pa'i bdag 'chang ba po nam mkha'i khams las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ de bzhin du rtsa sngags dang bcas te ming spel 'gres sbyar la/ chu'i khams las= sa yi khams las= me'i khams las= rlung gi khams las= de rgyab mu khyud la rtsa sngags dang ming spel bcas byas la/ shags thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ bu lon thams cad= 'dod pa thams cad= rtsod pa thams cad= bsam pa thams cad= de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la rim pa ltar rtsa sngags sbyar la/ 'chang ba po nad thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ 'jigs pa thams cad=

phyogs thams cad= shags thams cad= rtsod pa thams cad= g.yul thams cad= dgra thams cad= bu lon thams cad= ces sngags mgo phyir bstan no// rtsibs mchan brgyad la/ nor bu rtse mo nang bstan re re bri'o// de rgyab mu khyud la sngags mgo nang bstan du sngags dang 'dod gsol 'khor lo'i rtsibs su yod pa ltar bri'o// de rgyab mu khyud la yig mgo phyir bstan gyi sngags dang ming spel gong ltar byas la/ ma rig pa las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ 'du byed las= rnam par shes pa las= ming dang gzugs las= skye mched drug las= reg pa las= tshor ba las= sred pa las= len pa las= srid pa las= skye ba las= rga shi las= de rgyab mu khyud la ye dharmā bris pa'i sham du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag rtsod pa las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bri/ de rgyab khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dpe'u ris ltar bri/ de rgyab me ri bri'o// ༈ //de nas gong gi rdo leb gnyis la sngar bzhin thebs dang sprad la/ dug shog la zhabs 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang*/ steng 'khor la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bri/ de gnyis ka'i lte bar oṃ dang zhabs su phu re re bri/ zhabs 'khor yig mgo thams cad nang du bstan la lte bar rtsa sngags dang 1$0000230che ge 1$0000270pham par gyur cig 1$0000300 1$0000270swā hā/ de rgyab pad+ma 'dab brgyad la rtsa sngags yi ge 'bru brgyad bkod/ de rgyab mu khyud la rtsa sngags sham du 1$0000230che ge 1$0000270pham par gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bri/ steng 'khor gyi yi ge mgo thams cad phyir bstan la/ lte bar rtsa sngags dang bdag rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ de rgyab rtsibs brgyad la rtsa sngags yi ge 'bru brgyad bkod/ de rgyab mu khyud la yang rtsa sngags sham du bdag rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bri'o// de nas gong gi rdo leb kyi pho 'khor mo 'khor gnyis la/

rang gi shog bu'i pho 'khor mo 'khor gnyis bag chus sbyar/ ling rkyang gcig bris la snying gar nṛ dzaḥ'i brgyan khug dang dzaḥdzaḥyis bskor/ liṅga'i rgyab tu rtsa sngags mjug tu 1$0000230che ge 1$0000270pham par gyur cig swā hā/ g.yon skor du bri/ snying gar dgra gang yin gyi ming rus bla dwags bris mthar pham par gyur cig ces bri/ de'i nṛ mig phug pa'i nang du tshon skud sne lnga gcig tu bsgril ba'i sne mo 'dren pa/ sbal 'khor gnyis kyi bar du mgo 'phongs ngos su 1$0000230 dpe gcig tu phyogs gcig tu zhes snang*/1$0000270liṅga de bstan la bcug go /tshon skud 'dom gang tsam gyi mtho gang yar phud la bskor sa byed/ de 'phro rting par phud nas rdo 'khor rgya gram du bcings la dam por dkris/ bar thams cad spra tshil gyis byugs la rlung mi thar bar bya'o// rkang zhabs 'khor lo liṅga ling rtse can de la dgra bo bkug bstim lha dbye dang bcas pa byas la/ thun khung nang du gan rkyal mgo rang la bstan pa'i steng du sāts+tsha rab gnas can gcig bzhag /drag po'i snod nang du thun rdzas yungs dkar yang bzhag go /1$0000300 de nas gzhi ma dkar po'am maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du nas kyi tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i phyi rol du/ phyi mchod rnam lnga dang*/ nang mchod bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma ci 'byor rgyun gtor dang bcas pa shas brgyan la bsham/ sman raka kyang bsham/ bye brag tu 'di'i gtor ma ni/ sbrang chang dang mar khu bsres la nor bu 'bar ba bzo/ ngos dang zur thams cad kyang nor bus brgyan/ steng du mar gyis nyi zla gza' skar mar thag bcas bre/ tha ma mtheb kyus bskor nas khra dpung nge byas te maṇ+ḍal gyi steng khri'i khar bzhag la dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis bskor/ de nas srung 'khor bsang sbyang dang bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod byas la sgrub gtor gyi mdun rin po che'i snod du 'thor nas dang bcas te bsham mo//

༈ //gnyis pa dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i rim pa la gnyis te/ srung 'khor rab gnas bya ba dang sgrub pa dngos so// dang po la lnga ste/ lha bskyed pa dang*/ spyan 'dren zhing brtan bzhugs byed pa dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ bstod pa bya zhing thugs dam bskul ba dang*/ snying po bzla zhing rab gnas bya ba'o// dang po ni/ thun mgo thams cad du yi dam gyi sgom bzlas byas la/ oṃ swa bhā sogs dang*/ mdun gyi srung 'khor mi dmigs pa las/ khro bo a pa rā dzi ta sku mdog dkar po gzhon nu'i cha byad can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing*/ khro 'dzum mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rin po che'i dbyug pa las dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'byung ba/ g.yon gyis 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa bsnams pa'o// de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar mtshams kyi pho brang nas spyan drangs/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren zhing brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ ri rab ri yi rtse mo nas// byang shar mtshams kyi pho brang nas// gnod sbyin chen po gshegs su gsol// mthun pa'i rdzas la gshegs su gsol// gzugs dang gnyis med brtan par bzhugs// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ sgra snyan dag ni thams cad dang*// yid 'ong 'dod yon sna tshogs dang*// gser skyems tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan 'bul// dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa bzhes// puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi phung po chen por gyur/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te swā hā/

i daṃ ba liṃ ta la kha raṃ khā hi khā hi/ bzhi pa bstod pa bya zhing thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ ri rab ri yi rtse mo nas// byang shar mtshams kyi pho brang nas// lag na rdo rje'i rdzu 'phrul stobs// gnod sbyin gzhan gyis mi thub pa// pha rol dgra rnams pham byed cing*// rin chen gter gyi mnga' bdag mdzad// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel// 'dod pa mthar phyin khyod la bstod/ khye 'u mi ring gzugs 'dzin zhing*// zhi dang drag po'i phrin las mdzad// bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i// bar chad sel mdzad khyod la bstod// srid pa gsum gyi yid 'phrog cing*// lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud/ khams gsum kun la mnga' mdzad pa// dbang chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ khros pas pha rol 'ching bar 'gyur// mos pas rtsa gsum gnas su skyel// rdzu 'phrul bdag po khyod la bstod// tha skar dri med lha mo yang*/ khyod kyi yid 'phrog gzugs la chags// de bas khams gsum yid 'phrog pa// nor bdag gter bdag khyod la bstod// 'gro ba kun la sems bskyed cing*// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la// dngos grub sna tshogs ster mdzad pa// yid bzhin nor bu khyod la bstod// bdag la 'dod don dngos grub stsol// lnga pa snying po bzla zhing rab gnas bya ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams sprin phung 'dus pa ltar byon nas khrig ger bzhugs par bsam la/ bdag rtsod pa thams cad las rgyal bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis/ lha tshogs thams cad kyis bdag rgyal bar byin gyis brlabs shing dgra pham par byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te swā hā/ zhes rtsa sngags 'di stong tsam thon pa dang*/ skabs su sngags sham ni/

oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te bdag 'chang ba po bsod nams thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ de ltar rtsa sngags ming spel 'gres kun la sbyar zhing*/ nam mkha'i khams las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ chu'i khams las rgyal= sa'i khams las rgyal= me yi khams las rgyal= rlung gi khams las rgyal= shags thams cad las rgyal= bu lon thams cad las rgyal= 'dod pa thams cad las rgyal= rtsod pa thams cad las rgyal= bsam pa thams cad las rgyal= nad thams cad las rgyal= 'jigs pa thams cad las rgyal= phyogs thams cad las rgyal= shags thams cad las rgyal= rtsod pa thams cad las rgyal= g.yul thams cad las rgyal= dgra thams cad las rgyal= bu lon thams cad las rgyal= ma rig pa las rgyal= 'du byed las rgyal= rnam par shes pa las rgyal= ming dang gzugs las rgyal= skye mched drug las rgyal= reg pa las rgyal= tshor ba las rgyal= sred pa las rgyal= len pa las rgyal= srid pa las rgyal= skye ba las rgyal= rga shi las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ zhes lan bdun bdun tsam rtsa sngags dang sbrel la 'don/ de nas ye dharmā brjod la srung 'khor la me tog gtor/ bkra shis brjod/ de ltar zhag bdun tsam rab gnas byas la rang gzhan la btags pa'am/ yang na da gzod sgrub pa thon nas 'dogs so// ༈ //gnyis pa sgrub pa dngos la gnyis te/ snga dro bdag rgyal bya ba dang*/ phyi dro gzhan pham par bya ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ bdag rgyal bya zhing rdo 'khor bskor ba dang*/ dgra bo bkug cing liṅgar bstim pa dang*/ dgos dmigs byas te bu lon bkug pa'o// dang po snga dro bdag rgyal bya ba ni/ rang nyid yi dam bsgoms pa'i mdun du a pa rā dzi ta sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu g.yon bum pa bsnams par bsgoms la/ spro na gong ltar spyan 'dren mchod bstod byas la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi a pa rā dzi ta la phog /de las de 'dra ba grangs med pa spros pas rigs drug gi tshe dang bsod nams/

khyad par du bsgrub bya'i tshe dang bsod nams bden pa thams cad bkug nas/ rang dang mdun gyi a pa rā la thim par bsam la/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te bdag rtsod pa thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ zhes sngags de nyid brgya rtsa brgyad re thon nas/ rdo 'khor g.yas bskor re byas te dmigs pa ni/ rdo leb steng ma de gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad g.yas su bskor/ 'og ma de sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad g.yon du bskor ba de gnyis kyi bar du kho'i dbang po kha zhabs bzlog nas/ kho'i tshe dang bsod nams bkrag dang gzi mdangs longs spyod dang bde ba thams cad skyugs nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo a pa rā dzi ta sku mdog dkar po g.yas lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa zhig 'phros pas/ kho yi skyug pa de gsol bas bkrag gzi mdangs dang ldan nas/ rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam la sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te bdag bsod nams thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ rtsa sngags ming spel de bzhin du kun la 'gre 'o// bdag nam mkha'i khams las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ chu'i khams las rgyal= sa yi khams las rgyal= me'i khams las rgyal= rlung gi khams las rgyal= shags thams cad las rgyal= bu lon thams cad las rgyal= 'dod pa thams cad las rgyal= rtsod pa thams cad las rgyal= bsam pa thams cad las rgyal= nad thams cad las rgyal= 'jigs pa thams cad las rgyal= phyogs thams cad las rgyal= shags thams cad las rgyal= rtsod pa thams cad las rgyal= g.yul thams cad las rgyal= dgra thams cad las rgyal= bu lon thams cad las rgyal= ma rig pa las rgyal= 'du byed las rgyal= rnam par shes pa las rgyal= ming dang gzugs las rgyal= skye mched drug las rgyal= reg pa las rgyal= tshor ba las rgyal= sred pa las rgyal= len pa las rgyal= srid pa las rgyal= skye ba las rgyal= rga shi las rgyal bar gyur cig / ces tshar gsum brjod la sbal pa mgo tshur bstan la bzhag go

/de lta bu nyin phyed bar lan gsum bya'o// ༈ //gnyis pa dgra bo bkug cing liṅga la bstim pa ni/ nyin phyed kyi dus su rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du a pa rā dzi ta sku mdog nag po g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa bsnams par bskyed la/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod bya/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer a pa rā dzi ta la phog pas/ de las de 'dra ba grangs med pa 'phros pas dmigs bya rang dbang med par bkug nas liṅga la yang yang thim par bsgom la/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te dgra bo che ge khug khug pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing bkug /lan bzhi gyer/ nub mo yang lan bzhi gyer/ de ltar dus brgyad du 'gugs gzhug bya/ 'gugs sngags dang las bzhi bya/ de phyin chad mi dgos so// ༈ //gsum pa dgos dmigs byas te bu lon bkug pa ni/ rang gi bu lon tshur blang dgos na rdo 'khor steng du sbrang dum gcig bzhag la/ rang yi dam bsgoms pa'i mdun du a pa rā sku mdog nag po g.yas lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa dang*/ gnam sa brdab pa dang*/ nyi zla brdab pa dang*/ ri rab brdab pa rnams kyi bar du dmigs bya bsam la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi de rnams la phog pas/ de rnams kyis dmigs bya cer cer btang bas kho'i kha rje dbang thang dpal dang grags pa bkrag dang gzi brjid tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dpal 'byor bden pa thams cad shag shag nas/ bdag gi bden pa'i snod du gyur nas bdag bkrag mdangs dang ldan par

bsam la/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te bdag bu lon thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig swā hā/ khyad par du dgra bo thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs kho la bsdu/ kho'i bkrag mdangs bsod nams nor rdzas thams cad bdag la 'dus par bsam la/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyang sems rtse gcig tu dril nas dmigs pa gsal yang yang gdab cing gong gi sngags 'di dag brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te rang gi lce thog tu bzhag pas kho'i bkrag mdangs longs spyod thams cad bdag gis thob par bsam mo// de ltar byas pas shin tu myur ba'o// ༈ //gnyis pa phyi dro gzhan pham par bya ba ni/ rang gi mdun du mtsho nag la gting zab pa'i nang du sbal pa dkar nag gnyis lto ba kha sbyor ba'i bar du nṛ las dgra bo rid cing lus skam pa yi dwags 'dra ba zhig tu bsam la/ kho sbal pa dkar nag gi ltor tshud nas sbal pa'i rkang lag bzhi yis yar 'khyud mar 'khyud byas pas kho la 'gul dbang dang smra dbang med cing dbang po kha zhabs log par bsam la/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te dgra bo 'di rtsod pa thams cad las pham par gyur cig swā hā/ zhes sngags brgya re thon pa dang*/ sngags sham ni/ oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te dgra bo 'di bsod nams thams cad las pham par gyur cig swā hā/ mgo mjug sngar bzhin 'gres bya'o// nam mkha'i khams las pham= chu'i khams las pham= sa yi khams las pham= me'i khams las pham= rlung gi khams las pham= shags thams cad las pham= bu lon thams cad las pham= 'dod pa thams cad las pham= rtsod pa thams cad las pham= bsam pa thams cad las pham= nad thams cad las pham= 'jigs pa thams cad las pham= phyogs thams cad las pham= shags thams cad las pham= rtsod pa thams cad las pham= g.yul thams cad las pham= dgra thams cad las pham= bu lon thams cad las pham= ma rig pa las pham= 'du byed las pham= rnam par shes pa las pham= ming dang gzugs las pham= skye mched drug las pham= reg pa las pham=

tshor ba las pham= sred pa las pham= len pa las pham= srid pa las pham= skye ba las pham= rga shi las pham par gyur cig swā hā/ zhes lan bdun tsam brjod la yungs dkar gyis brub khung nang gi rkang zhabs 'khor lo ling rtse can de brab bo// de nas sbal 'khor g.yon du bskor la tshig 'di brjod/ dgra bo che ge 'di'i lus dang yan lag bcings nas 'gul mi shes par gyur cig /ngag dang lce bcings nas smra mi shes par gyur cig /yid dang sems bcings nas bsam mi shes par gyur cig /lus ngag yid gsum bya spu mes 'tshig pa bzhin du thongs shig / ces brjod la sbal pa mgo phar bstan la bzhag go /de lta bu lan gsum mam mang du bya'o// ༈ //gzhan gyi bu lon rang gis phar 'jal dgos na/ dgra bo'i gzugs bzos la zam gog gi nang du bzhag / 'jig rten khams kyi yi dwags thams cad bkug nas kho la bstim/ kho la nus pa med cing rid pa skam pa nyam thag pa yi dwags 'dra ba gcig bsam la/ nub mo'i dus su lan chags changs ril la/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sogs kyis bsngo/ lan chags zam nang gzugs mdun du spung*/ de nas sgrub pa zhag bdun nam gsum mam ci nus byas pa'i nub mo thun mjug la/ las sngags 'di dang sbrel la bklag go / oṃ hrīḥ.a pa rā dzi ta a dzi te hrīḥdzaḥ che ge zlog zlog 'ur 'ur chem chem nal nal dgra bo che ge mo pham par gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la thun rdeg go /de ltar sgrub pa'i dus su dam tshig la khyi dang bud med sha chang sgog gsum spang*/ sgrub pa thon nas srung 'khor 'dogs pa'i dus su sngar gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlabs par bsgom mo// ༈ //gsum pa rjes gnan pa'i rim pa ni/ sbal 'khor sngags mtshams su ming yig yod pa brad de 'gol sar bzhag /bar gyi liṅga rkyang pa de chu mig gi kha nub bstan klu gdol pa gnas pa'i sar phur pa brdung ba'i shul du bcug la dmod bcol 'di ltar bya'o//

'o chu mig 'di la gnas pa'i klu bdud nag po khyod la dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di zas skal du gtad do// ma shor cig /'thung skal du gtad do ma shor cig / ces sogs shes tshad brjod nas/ rdo leb la rdo rje rgya gram bris pas dong kha gcad/ de ltar ma 'dzom na lam rgya gram mam mchod rten sogs kyi zhabs su gnan/ zam gog nang gi dgra gzugs de dang changs ril thams cad chu bo'i gzhung la bskur ro// rkang zhabs kyi 'khor lo de re ba zur gsum nang du bcug la de l+h+wam g.yon pa'i nang du rkang rting du phog par byas la bcug nas/ rang nyid 'gro lam 'dug sdod dus snga dro phyi dro gong dang 'dra bar byas la sngags bzla'o// yang na ling rkyang dang lhan cig tu gnyis ka mnyam du gnan pa bya'o// de ltar gnod sbyin rdo 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs// gnam sa'i tsakra bskor ba zhes bya 'di// man ngag yig chung kun las mdor bsdus nas/ kho bo nam mkha' rin chen bdag gis bkod// 'khrul na bzod gsol ma 'khrul dge ba des// dgra sdang tshar gcod bstan pa dar rgyas shog// /
